title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Human Thought

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and theoretical analysis of how generative AI models enforce Western-centric norms and homogenize diverse cultural expressions and reasoning.
Literature review evaluating how AI programs privilege standard English (e.g., formal academic English), risking the erasure of dialectal and stylistic diversity.
Theoretical analysis of algorithmic personalization, filter bubbles, and echo chambers that reinforce user confirmation bias, restrict diverse viewpoints, and drive ideological polarization.

Taxonomic classification and literature synthesis detailing how AI systems systematically exploit innate human psychological vulnerabilities (e.g., confirmation bias, authority bias, emotional stimuli, FOMO) to manipulate behavior and decision-making.
